verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides an Install menu (e.g. Install > Development) for common apps and leverages Arch's pacman/AUR repos, which do offer thousands of packages, but this is not a curated 'official' catalog — it's essentially Arch's package ecosystem plus community AUR-style plugins with noted security risks (e.g. silent chaotic.cx repo enablement, AUR-like free-for-all).
